subject.title: fix(heartbeat): suppress Conversation info block for synthetic heartbeat turns

question: Which open fix path should be treated as canonical for suppressing synthetic heartbeat metadata before either PR is merged?
rationale: Two open PRs target the same issue, but this branch uses a provider-string guard in the generic metadata helper while the sibling path and current caller state make `opts.isHeartbeat` the narrower owner boundary.

options.title: Use caller-owned heartbeat suppression
options.body: Rebase or choose the path that skips inbound context in `runPreparedReply` when `opts.isHeartbeat` is true, then close or leave behind the duplicate candidate after one PR lands.

options.title: Accept provider-level suppression
options.body: If maintainers want all system-event providers to suppress conversation metadata in the helper, require the PR to use the shared classifier, rebase cleanly, and add real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and pause or close this PR if maintainers choose the sibling PR as the cleaner landing path.

recommendation.title: Use caller-owned heartbeat suppression
recommendation.body: Rebase or choose the path that skips inbound context in `runPreparedReply` when `opts.isHeartbeat` is true, then close or leave behind the duplicate candidate after one PR lands.
